reasoning: Kept both distinct corrections. The bare-list rule extends the existing guidance on implicit questions, while the qualifier rule clarifies how to apply requested specificity without automatically including every contextual descriptor. Placed them after separate existing paragraphs and left the protected section unchanged.

edits.target: Identify the specific entity, attribute, or relation requested before answering. Treat clue-like statements or fragments as implicit questions and return the missing value, not a judgment about whether the statement is true. Give the named referent rather than a related person, description, or broad topic; use a true/false answer only when explicitly requested.
edits.content: - When a prompt consists only of comma-separated names or entities, inspect the context for a clearly supported shared attribute (such as a state, country, institution, or category) and return that value rather than narrating a relationship, chronology, or succession. Do not infer a shared attribute if the context does not support one.

edits.target: Return one concise canonical answer at exactly the requested level of specificity. For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component; do not repeat information already given in the clue or add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer. For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles. Use a full canonical personal name when the clue does not supply a name component; when it supplies part of a name and asks for completion, give only the missing component. Avoid explanations and alternatives.
edits.content: In short clue-style prompts, descriptors such as a place type, location, or campus may identify the answer without belonging in its response form. Give the conventional name at the level requested; do not automatically append a geographic or branch/campus qualifier merely because context supplies a fuller label. Include such a qualifier when the clue asks for it or it is needed to distinguish the requested referent.
